oracle_judgments: Each program separately calls and counts a seed procedure that defines every observed storage unit to a negative sentinel before the writer runs, so no observation and no mutation reads undefined COMMON storage.

Readers compare each actual COMMON coordinate against independent literals 11/22/33/44, as one four-element tuple or as separate left 11/22 and right 33/44 tuples. No commutative sum, address, byte layout, emitted assembly, TRANSFER result or same-processor round trip is used.
Control arguments are distinct initialized driver scalars rather than COMMON members, so no dummy-argument aliasing with COMMON storage is relied on.

Named blocks carry SAVE /block/ in every declaring procedure; the blank-common case deliberately has no SAVE, DATA or declaration initialization and relies on the blank-common retention rules of 8.10.2.5 and 19.6.6.
Entries, writes, observations and normal returns are counted, nine counted caller checks precede completion, and completion is an exact external stdout oracle with empty runtime stderr and exit 0.

The four facets are genuinely distinguished: one statement with repeated /packet/ groups, successive named statements, the omitted-name plus // spellings of the same blank block, and interleaved /left_block/ and /right_block/ statements whose separate tuples would expose cross-block contamination.
